# Niles

> Rust CLI that runs Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and pi as one team in tmux. Unix only.

To set Niles up in a repository, load the `niles-setup` skill, or read it directly and follow it.

## Set up

- [Install](https://github.com/Rhovian/niles/blob/main/skills/niles-setup/SKILL.md#2-install): Homebrew, the shell installer, or Cargo.
- [Write the manifest](https://github.com/Rhovian/niles/blob/main/skills/niles-setup/SKILL.md#3-write-the-manifest): `~/.niles/state/<workspace-key>/manifest.yaml`, chosen with the user.
- [Check with niles doctor](https://github.com/Rhovian/niles/blob/main/skills/niles-setup/SKILL.md#4-check-with-niles-doctor)
- [Start the workspace](https://github.com/Rhovian/niles/blob/main/skills/niles-setup/SKILL.md#5-hand-off-to-start): the user runs `niles`.
